title: Conservation Argument
description: Essential Criteria: The response must clearly state that pair production by a single isolated photon is impossible due to the violation of energy and momentum conservation.

title: Threshold Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The response must provide the correct expression for the threshold energy for pair production, E_gamma = 2m_e.

title: Recoil Energy Justification
description: Important Criteria: The response should include a calculation or reasoning showing that the kinetic energy of the recoiling nucleus is negligible compared to the threshold energy.

title: Numerical Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The response must include a numerical evaluation of the kinetic energy of the recoiling nucleus and its relation to E_gamma.

title: Momentum Transfer Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The response may explain how a nearby particle allows for momentum conservation during pair production.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid unit mistakes, ensuring that all energy values are consistently expressed in MeV.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response must avoid sign mistakes in the calculations related to energy and momentum.
